sentences.text:
Sasanka Mondal @ Khundo vs Unknown on 10 June, 2025
10.6.2025
 Sl. 15
Samarpita
Court No.655
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 Cra 84 of 2006

In the Matter of: Sasanka Mondal @ Khundo  .... Appellant  Mr. Partho Sarathi Bhattacharya,
 Mrs. Sukla Das Chandra,
 Mr. Bhaskar Seth  ... for the appellant  Ms. Amita Gaur,
 Ms. Afreen Begam  ..... for the State  1.
Appellant is represented by the learned Advocate.

3. It is said by the learned Advocate for the appellant that the appellant/convict had already served out the sentence as passed by the learned Trial Court in the impugned judgement and order of the conviction dated 8.12.2005 and 9.5.2005 in connection with Sessions Trial Case No. 52 of 2003 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 544/1995 arising out of Bharatpur P.S. Case No. 53/95 dated 8.9.1995 under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
4. A certificate issued by the Superintendent of Central Correctional Home is handed over by the learned Advocate during course of hearing.

5. Learned Advocate for the State is requested to obtain a report from the Superintendent,
Berhampore Central Correctional Home and submit the same on the date fixed.
6. Let the matter be listed on 18th June, 2025.
